Use this page to choose a common layout cell or a registered cross-section.

| Start with | What it provides |
| --- | --- |
| [Launcher](#launcher){.text-nowrap} | A pad-to-CPW transition. |
| [Resonator](#resonator){.text-nowrap} | A CPW hanger and meander layout. |
| [Cross-sections](#cross-sections){.text-nowrap} | Registered width, offset, layer, and port recipes for paths. |

## Launcher

`launcher` tapers a large pad to a CPW neck and marks the pad-side simulation
boundary. The default layout is shown below; see the [Launcher guide](../public-pdk-examples/components/launcher.qmd)
for its settings and ports.

![Default launcher layout showing the pad, taper, and CPW neck.](../_static/images/components/launcher.svg)

## Resonator

`resonator` combines a CPW hanger and meander, with optional tail and qubit
segment geometry. The [Resonator guide](../public-pdk-examples/components/resonator.qmd)
covers its settings and layout interfaces.

![Default resonator layout.](../_static/images/components/resonator.svg)

## Cross-sections

Choose a registered cross-section to define widths, transverse offsets, layers,
and connection ports along a path. Browse the [Cross-sections guide](../public-pdk-examples/cross-sections.qmd)
for registered choices and default previews.
